full.description: This image is a dental X-ray showing the mandible and surrounding teeth. A large radiolucent lesion is visible in the posterior region of the jaw, causing displacement and resorption of adjacent tooth roots. The radiographic presentation demonstrates a well-defined cystic or expansile process within the bone. Based on these features, the appearance is consistent with an odontogenic cyst or tumor.

random.description: This is a dental or mandibular X-ray showing the lower jaw and teeth. A large radiolucent (dark) lesion or cystic area is visible in the body of the mandible surrounding tooth roots and extending into the bone. The surrounding bone shows remodeling and displacement of structures due to the expansive lesion. The presentation is characteristic of an odontogenic cyst or tumor, such as an ameloblastoma or keratocystic odontogenic tumor.
